entities.name: Biborat
entities.description: Mercenary on Shandalar hired by the Onakke spirits to return a chest with the key to the Onakke Catacombs.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who tried to hire the mercenaries to break into the viceroy's palace.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact Liliana would come to claim.

events.summary: Liliana barges in and proposes the mercenaries break into the viceroy's palace so she can kill him.
events.quote: Liliana planned for the mercenaries to handle the viceroy's guards while she killed him

events.summary: An angel hunting the mercenaries fills Harcu with golden light until he disintegrates.
events.quote: the angel filled his body with golden light until he disintegrated

events.summary: The angel disintegrates Dalto the same way.
events.quote: before she filled Dalto with golden light and disintegrated him

events.summary: Liliana blasts the angel with death magic and is killed by Biborat's last remaining associate.
events.quote: Liliana blasted her with death magic

events.summary: Biborat returns the chest to the Onakke Catacombs and the spirits promise a reward.

relations.quote: hired by the spirits of the Onakke
